passage.t: Plants have tiny holes called stomata on their leaves and stems that allow them to take in carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen into the air.
when water loss is especially severe, some plants close their stomata temporarily. Another special adaptation is thick, waxy coatings on plant leaves that help conserve water.

tasks.analysis: Plants have tiny holes called stomata on their leaves and stems that allow them to take in carbon dioxide from the air and release oxygen into the air. However, stomata can also let water vapor escape, which causes problems in dry environments. To manage this, during hot periods when water loss is especially severe, some plants close their stomata temporarily. Another special adaptation is thick, waxy coatings on plant leaves that help conserve water. 植物的叶片和茎上有叫作气孔的微小孔洞，能吸收空气中的二氧化碳并释放氧气。然而，气孔也会让水蒸气散失，这在干燥环境中会造成问题。为应对这种情况，在水分流失特别严重的炎热时段，一些植物会暂时关闭气孔。另一种特殊适应方式是叶片上厚实的蜡质表层，有助于保存水分。
